$meta.readThisFirst: Singh's 2026-09-03 request: build the global Tabs component styles. He RULED both styles are in scope and named them PRIMARY (underline, 5775:8556) and SECONDARY (segmented, 27329:70805), and he ADDED a disabled state to Primary (27334:72865) during the session. Per his standing instruction, the `behavior` and `purpose` blocks are mandatory. One value discrepancy was found on the new disabled token — see defect T1; it is flagged, not silently resolved.

purpose: Two official tab styles for the whole product. PRIMARY (underline) switches between top-level sections of a page or record — a row of text tabs where the current one is marked by a brand-blue underline. SECONDARY (segmented) is a compact joined pill group for nested tabs, sub-sections, or on/off filter groups — the selected segment fills solid blue. Using one shared pair everywhere keeps tabbing consistent across every screen.

primary.role: Underline tab row for top-level sections.
parts: optional Empty filler that extends the baseline to the row's end

secondary.role: Segmented pill group for nested / sub / filter tabs.
parts: each segment = centered label; corners round only at the row's Start and End

labelRightGap.note: right padding on the label = the gap to the next tab.

disabled.label: action/disabled/text-neutral
disabled.note: Added by Singh 2026-09-03 (node 27334:72865). VALUE MISMATCH on the label token — see defect T1.

empty.value: 22px filler, grey baseline (field/border-default), no label — extends the underline past the last tab.

cornerRadius.note: Only at the row Start (first) and End (last); Mid segments are square.

typography.note: Primary uses Fields/header (Inter Medium 14/20). Secondary uses Fields/value (Inter Regular 12/16). No new type styles.

colourFormula.pattern: Primary label goes text/secondary → text/primary (hover) → text/brand (selected) → action/disabled/text-neutral (disabled); its baseline goes field/border-default → border/focus → action/primary/bg → action/disabled/bg. Secondary segment is border/subtle+text/primary (inactive) → action/secondary/hover fill + border/brand + action/secondary/text (hover) → action/primary/bg fill + action/primary/text-neutral (active). Every token resolves in the repo with dark/hc/warm variants — verified 2026-09-03; the only value discrepancy is defect T1.

roles.value: Both styles are role="tablist" of role="tab"; the current tab is aria-selected="true" (drives the Selected/active visual), tied to its panel via aria-controls. Disabled primary tabs get aria-disabled="true" + tabindex="-1".

keyboard.value: Arrow keys move between tabs with a roving tabindex; Home/End jump to first/last — the standard WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Not drawn in Figma but required.

contrast.value: Secondary hover text (action/secondary/text → blue-700) is contrast-verified 5.30:1 AA (token comment). Primary selected/brand text on white passes. Disabled contrast depends on T1's resolution — flag.

focusVisible.value: Every tab/segment keeps a visible focus ring.

defects: T1 — DISABLED LABEL VALUE MISMATCH (Primary). The new disabled variant (27334:72865) binds action/disabled/text-neutral, whose Figma-resolved value reads #475569 — identical to text/secondary, i.e. a disabled tab's label would look the same colour as a normal Default tab's label. The repo, however, resolves --action-disabled-text-neutral to neutral-300 (a lighter grey), which is the more sensible disabled look. Figma and the repo disagree on this token's value. The CSS binds the TOKEN name (correct); Singh / Figma AI must reconcile the intended value. Do not hardcode either side.

T2 — LEGACY TOKEN NAME: letter-spacing binds fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0 (X- legacy prefix) on both styles — the same system-wide legacy-name cleanup already tracked. Do not propagate the X- name; the kit uses semantic vars.

T3 — SECONDARY 'badge indicators' NOT MEASURED. The component reports 27 variants 'covering states and badge indicators', but only Size=S × Active × Status × Default/Hover were read. Any count-badge variant on a segment was not captured — read it before using badges on secondary tabs.
T4 — SECONDARY is size S only in the read set. If a larger (M/L) segmented size is needed, it was not found and must be measured.

T5 — SECONDARY has no measured Active+Hover combo and no disabled segment; PRIMARY has no measured Active+Hover-of-a-different-tab nuance. States beyond those listed are not defined in Figma — treat as out of scope until drawn.

primarySelect.effect: Switches the page/record to that section; the clicked tab becomes Selected (brand-blue label + underline) and its panel shows. Only one tab is Selected at a time.

primaryDisabled.effect: Shown greyed with a faint baseline and is not clickable or focusable. Used when a section isn't available for this record/context.

primaryEmpty.effect: The Empty filler simply continues the grey baseline to the end of the row so the underline spans the full width even past the last real tab.

secondarySelect.effect: Selects that segment (solid blue fill, white text); the others stay outlined. One active at a time. Used for nested sub-tabs or a single-choice filter group.

hover.effect: Primary: label darkens and the baseline turns blue. Secondary: segment fills light-blue with a blue border and blue text. Signals it's clickable.
